content/en/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/.body:
_Pods_ are the smallest deployable units of computing that you can create and manage in Kubernetes.
A Pod runs containers.

## What is a Pod?

Note: You need to install a [container runtime](/docs/setup/production-environment/container-runtimes)
into each node.

FEATURE STATE: Kubernetes v1.24 [stable]

A Pod represents a set of running containers in your cluster.

Here is an example Pod:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.14.2
    ports:
    - containerPort: 80
```

Caution: Do not delete Pods by hand.

Use the Linux node image.

### Windows

Use the Windows node image.
